reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out and it works for me. $29.99 is more than what I pay now, and I have no reason to switch.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. A lab report is nice, but I'm not paying extra for it.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or under what I pay for Toplux, or a free first box so I can try it next to what I take now.
